suspicion: Payload school could be reconstructed from a different spell than the effect's owner (identity drift between compiler and consumer)
why_rejected: Resolved program steps carry only effect_index; effects are owned by the program spell, and school is taken from that payload spell once (program.rs:1124) and reused for immunity, modifiers, absorbs and share.

suspicion: Incoming mechanic-filtered damage modifiers use spell-level mechanic mask instead of per-effect mechanic
why_rejected: Binding uses the payload spell's all-effect mechanic mask (program/modifier.rs:1507-1530), matching Trinity SpellDamageBonusTaken's GetAllEffectsMechanicMask semantics.

suspicion: Outgoing school damage modifiers on multi-school payloads should multiply all matching auras
why_rejected: Core takes the per-school product then the max across payload schools (damage_modifier.rs:247-252), matching Trinity's player branch of SpellDamagePctDone (max over ModDamageDonePercent per school).

suspicion: Damage-immunity program audit omits ProgramOp::PowerBurn, letting burn damage reach an Ethereal holder (debug_assert admits_payload)
why_rejected: compile_pool_plans rejects Power Burn whenever any immunity family is declared (UnsupportedImmunityPlan).

suspicion: Share Damage copies only the aura source's own damage while Trinity copies every attacker's damage
why_rejected: Divergence is unreachable: with the exact Venomshade plan compiled, state construction rejects any topology beyond the source/target pair (UnsupportedShareDamageTopology), so no third party can damage the holder.

suspicion: Target absorb bypass aggregates multiple sources additively
why_rejected: Percentage points fold with f64::max (target_absorb_bypass_authority.rs:143), matching Trinity GetMaxPositiveAuraModifierByMiscMask.

suspicion: Commit-time absorb consumption re-derives candidate order and could diverge from the quote
why_rejected: Commit consumes the quoted ordered snapshot (next_snapshot) and skips candidates whose generation/sequence changed; order is carried, not reconstructed.

suspicion: School-immunity coverage uses intersection (any covered school) instead of full coverage
why_rejected: Both compile audit and runtime use complete-subset coverage (incoming & !provider == 0), matching Trinity (immuneMask & schoolMask) == schoolMask.

suspicion: A second damage operation in one impact after a lethal first operation is checked against committed (alive) health and could deal damage
why_rejected: The health quote workspace projects the first operation's lethal result; the second quote_damage reads projected current 0 and applies 0 (HealthPool::quote_damage_from min(current)); only the dead_target signal differs from the healing path's projected check (INCONSISTENT, no wrong state).

suspicion: Damage immunity or no-immunity bypass payload could be suppressed/admitted by spell rather than exact effect
why_rejected: admits_payload/suppresses_payload compare exact SpellEffectRef (damage_immunity.rs:124-130); raw-29 bypass is an exact effect predicate (no_immunities.rs:50-53).

suspicion: Self-applied periodic damage of a covered school bypasses raw-39 like raw-165 (caster-recipient route)
why_rejected: Periodic tick child programs execute Target-recipient impacts on the aura recipient (resolved periodic damage tick nodes), so the raw-39 compile audit (has_target_impact) inspects them and rejects covered non-applicand programs; only direct caster-recipient payloads such as raw-165 escape. Static argument; not probed.
